title: AudienceMember
description: One membership change for an ad-platform audience list. Identifiers are SHA-256 hex of the value normalised FOR THIS PLATFORM (normalization.ts hashEmailFor/hashPhoneFor/hashExternalIdFor); a Reddit email hash is not a Meta email hash. user_id is internal lineage and is never sent.

reason.description: snake_case reason, e.g. high_predicted_profit, negative_predicted_profit_suppression, paying_customer_suppression, refund_or_chargeback_suppression.

value.description: Optional seed value for value-based lookalikes (Meta LOOKALIKE_VALUE must be non-negative).
